description: Public and student area: models/services/controllers/routes for plan sections 3.2 and 3.3 (public dojos/classes/sessions/packages, trial booking, registration with auto-activation, student home/profile/packages/timetable/bookings/attendance/payments/grading/feedback/MC) and the rewiring of the landing pages and all student portal pages to the API. Depends on FEAT-001. Independent of FEAT-003 and FEAT-004/005 except that registrationService.activate is reused by FEAT-004.
steps: Read plan.md sections 1 (D10, D15, D19-D23), 3.2, 3.3, 5 (landing + student) and student_portal/student.js, landingpage/js/{join,trial,class,public}.js, and the data.js SEED() student parts. Open .db-tmp/agree.mjs to see how Lervyn's grade sessions (29 of 36) map to seed rows and decide the sessions-count derivation for gradingService; record it in findings.

Models: studentModel, packageModel, attendanceModel, sessionModel (HQ bookable sessions, week window, seats left), closureModel (read), paymentModel, mcModel, gradingModel (read + application insert), remarkModel (read), feedbackModel (anonymous insert + prompt), applicationModel (registration), guestModel, models/ids.js nextId. All SQL parameterised, executor argument for transactions.

Services: classRules.js (kids/Ladies/SG50/Intermediate sort_order>=3/Advanced sort_order>=6), packageService (D20 incl. status sweep), bookingService (D21 with HQ-only, windows from policy_setting, capacity, duplicate/overlap, credit pick, cancel window cancel_hours), gradingService + gradingRules (eligibility checks, needSessions per rank, fee by target rank + late fee, apply creates grading_application + payment in one tx), registrationService (fee calc from policy_setting + package_def + discounts, checklist rows from auto_activation_rule, auto-activation tx creating users/student_profile/membership/student_package/payments/equipment_order and returning a temp password, member no ASK-<year>-<4 digits> unique), trial/guest creation (users role guest with random unusable hash, guest_profile, guest_pass with amount_paid, optional class_attendance booked_via 'online').

Validators, controllers, routes: src/routes/{public,student}.routes.js plus validators/{public,student}.js (zod .strict()). Student routes use req.user.id only; add requireRole('student'). Public write routes (trial, registration) get the rate limiter. Implement every endpoint of plan 3.2 and 3.3 with the errors listed in D21/D22 (CLASS_FULL, NOT_ELIGIBLE, NO_CREDIT, ALREADY_BOOKED, PACKAGE_LIMIT, TOO_LATE, ...).

Front end: add src/public/student_portal/student-data.js and src/public/landingpage/js/public-data.js (ASK.load/ASK.act per plan section 4/5, converting ISO strings to Dates and server fields to the legacy shapes) and add them to each page's data-then list. Convert student.js: remove seedBookings, checkEnded/queueRating local logic (server rateQueue), local credit math (passes come from the server; keep helper functions as read-only views), local booking/cancel/buy/MC/grading submit mutations (call ASK.act then re-render), gaDemo toggles, all save() calls and NOW() for business times; renderBook builds slots from /student/timetable. Keep check-in mock working in memory only. Convert landing join.js (POST /public/registrations; show returned memberNo; drop APPS.unshift and ask-last-id) and trial.js (GET /public/sessions, POST /public/trial-bookings), class.js/public.js/about.js reading reference data.
Student login.js already posts to the API from FEAT-001: confirm the redirect and that the Lervyn demo path works from the real login form.

Write verification: .be-tmp/verify/api-public.mjs, api-student.mjs (booking rules for Lervyn: Ladies/kids/Advanced rejected with NOT_ELIGIBLE, Intermediate allowed at 4th Kyu; max 2 active packages (409 PACKAGE_LIMIT); credit decrement and Used up; cancel >= 4 h returns the lesson, < 4 h does not, using fixture sessions inserted relative to the server clock; duplicate and overlap; full class; price tampering ignored (client amount ignored); student A cannot read/cancel student B's booking, payment or grading application; anonymous feedback has no user column and requires attended lesson; extension requests; grading apply with fee 50 for 4th Kyu target 3rd Kyu... verify the fee by target rank; profile PATCH whitelist; 401/403 matrix) and browser-student.mjs (sign in as Lervyn, load every student + landing page at 1280/390 with zero console errors and failed requests, assert package credits and payments equal DB values, book a class then cancel it, screenshot index/book/packages/grading/profile into .be-tmp/screens/).
acceptance_criteria: All plan 3.2 and 3.3 endpoints exist, validate input, enforce ownership and the booking, package and grading rules, with SQL only in src/models.
Student home, book, packages, payments, grading, profile pages and the landing trial/join/fees/classes pages render data from the API with no localStorage/sessionStorage business data.
Lervyn sees 18 lessons left on the 25-lesson pack (seed value) and three payments; booking reduces credits by one and cancelling more than 4 hours ahead returns it.
A new join form submission creates a registration_application with checklist rows and auto-activates only when every enabled rule passes.
The mock check-in page still loads and does not throw.
verification: node .be-tmp/verify/reset-db.mjs && node .be-tmp/verify/api-public.mjs && node .be-tmp/verify/api-student.mjs: all checks pass
node .be-tmp/verify/browser-student.mjs: every student and landing page at 1280 and 390 px has zero console errors / failed requests; flows pass
findings:
VERIFIED (all run, after db.mjs + reset): api-public 40/40, api-student 118/118, api-auth 68/68 (regression), api-sqli 92/92, browser-student 67/67 (every student + landing page at 1280 and 390 with zero console errors/failed requests, values equal the db, book + cancel, profile save, trial and join through the real pages), browser-login 162/162 (instructor/admin portals still clean after the shared-file edits), npm test -- --runInBand exit 0. Nothing staged; .env/.gitignore/prompts untouched.

NEW BACKEND FILES: models {ids, studentModel, packageModel, paymentModel, attendanceModel, sessionModel, closureModel, mcModel, gradingModel, remarkModel, feedbackModel, applicationModel, guestModel, equipmentModel, policyModel, sentLogModel}; models/userModel gained findByEmail/insertUser/updateEmail; services {classRules, packageService, bookingService, gradingRules, gradingService, registrationService, trialService, studentService}; services/referenceService now also exports packageShape, policyShape; controllers {studentController, publicController}; routes {public.routes, student.routes} mounted in routes/index.js; validators {public, student}. All SQL is in models. Student routes use req.user.id only (authenticate + requireRole('student') on the whole router).

ENDPOINTS (all under /api/v1): public: GET /public/dojos|classes[?dojo]|packages|sessions?date, POST /public/trial-bookings, POST /public/registrations (last two use publicWriteLimiter). student: GET /student/home|profile|packages|timetable[?weekStart Monday, this week..+4]|bookings|attendance[?limit]|payments|payments/:id|grading; PATCH /student/profile (whitelist contactNo,email,emergencyContact,medicalNotes,guardianName,guardianContact); POST /student/packages {packageId,method}; POST /student/packages/:id/extension-requests {kind MC|Compassion,days,documentRef?}; DELETE /student/extension-requests/:id (extra: withdraw a waiting request, the page has a Withdraw button); POST /student/bookings {lessonId}; DELETE /student/bookings/:lessonId; POST /student/grading/applications {sessionId,bookFile,method}; DELETE /student/grading/applications/:id; POST /student/feedback {lessonId,rating,tags,note?,skipped?}. Error codes: NOT_ELIGIBLE 403 (booking, package audience, grading checklist), CLASS_FULL, ALREADY_BOOKED, TIME_CLASH, NO_CREDIT, TOO_LATE, TOO_EARLY, CLASS_CLOSED, PACKAGE_LIMIT, ALREADY_ACTIVE, NOT_BOOKED 404, NOT_BOOKABLE 403, MEMBERSHIP_INACTIVE 403, ALREADY_APPLIED, SESSION_CLOSED, TOP_RANK, NOT_WITHDRAWABLE, NOT_ATTENDED, ALREADY_RATED, ALREADY_PENDING, NOT_EXTENDABLE, EMAIL_IN_USE, TRIAL_USED, INVALID_WEEK/INVALID_DATE/INVALID_DOJO/INVALID_PACKAGE/INVALID_PASS.

SHARED SERVICES FOR LATER FEATS: registrationService.activate(tx, app, quoteLines, {reviewerId,note}) creates users/student_profile/membership/student_package/payments/equipment_order/sent_log and returns {userId, memberNo, tempPassword}; registrationService.activateApplication(tx, applicationId, reviewerId) re-checks every enabled checklist rule (409 RULES_NOT_MET) and calls activate: FEAT-004 should wrap it in withTx and return tempPassword to the desk (the public response NEVER contains a password). registrationService.quote({age,def,dogi},policies) and discountPct. bookingService.book/cancel/timetable take a `user` object ({id}) and can be reused by the desk with source 'desk' (needs a `via` parameter: attendanceModel.book already takes via 'online'|'desk'|'walk-in'|'waitlist'); packageModel.pickCredit/useLesson/returnLesson/sweep, attendanceModel.getRow/book/cancel/findOverlap, policyModel.getAll (typed policy map), sentLogModel.insert, ids.nextId(tx, table, column, prefix, width), classRules.whyNot(facts, session), gradingService.gradeFor(profile, db, today), gradingRules.summarise. studentModel.getProfile/findByMemberNo/lock. trialService.PASSES holds the guest-pass price table (no table in the db for it).

DECISIONS / DERIVATIONS TO CONFIRM:
1. Grading sessions count = floor(student_profile.accumulated_hours) (hours since the last PASSED grading; each attended 1 h class credits 1 hour, so 1 session = 1 hour; FEAT-003 attendance marking must add the class length to total/accumulated (+weapon) hours; promotion resets accumulated to 0). The seed has Lervyn at accumulated_hours 34, so the page shows 34 / 36, NOT the prototype's 29 / 36 (the seed never agreed with 29: .db-tmp/agree.mjs does not compare it). He is still not eligible (needs 36); the 'Simulate all requirements met' prototype link was removed. Need sessions per current rank come from gradingRules.NEED_SESSIONS (6k 24, 5k 30, 4k 36, 3k 36, 2k 48, 1k 60). Months in rank = whole months since last_passed_grading_date (joined_on if none) >= 6; member >= 3 months; 'fees paid' = no Outstanding payment + membership Active and not expired.
2. Lervyn has SEVEN payments in the seed (3 from the prototype + dogi + 2 grading fees + annual dues context), not three; the pages show all seven. Acceptance text 'three payments' cannot hold with this seed. His packs: SP-001 (25-lesson, 18 left, expires 2027-01-15) and SP-002 (25 of 25) = 43 lessons, 2 packages held = at the limit.
3. New members from the public join form do not receive a password (plan D15): the account gets a random hash, the done screen says the membership number only, and a sent_log welcome row is written. Until FEAT-004 returns a tempPassword to staff (or a reset flow exists) such a member cannot sign in. Confirm with the user.
4. Registration fee rules: registration_fee + annual_dues + dogi (fixed table 30/45/60 in registrationService.DOGI_PRICE, the HTML data-price values) + package price; senior/student discount (policy_setting) applies to the package price only, best of the two. Child = age <= 12 (join.js kid < 13); a child application needs a signer whose name differs from the child (guardian rule); applicants 13-20 sign with a guardian name but are in the Adult group. Existing email -> 409 EMAIL_IN_USE (users.email is unique).
5. Class check-in/QR stays in memory (todaysBooking/handleDojoScan/recordMyAttendance in store.js); no endpoint. After a mock scan the redirect reloads checkin.html, so the mock scan result is lost and the page falls back to the booked class. store.js recordMyAttendance remains for instructor.js (FEAT-003) and the mock scanner.
6. Cancel rule: >= policy cancel_hours (4) before start returns the lesson (Unlimited: nothing deducted); later keeps it; after the start 409 TOO_LATE. Booking window from policy_setting (min 1 day, 1 month ahead). Credit pick prefers an Unlimited plan, else the pack that expires first. Pack reaching 0 -> 'Used up', returns to 'Active' on an early cancel if not expired.
7. Anonymous rating: class_feedback row stores no student and created_at = midnight of the server day; class_feedback_prompt keeps (lesson,user,state). Rate queue = attended classes of the last 7 days not answered. Level-up cards = attended rows marked within 24 h (derived; reappear on reload for 24 h) + promotions within 7 days.
8. Profile page: Name is read-only (needs the office to change it), the separate 'Emergency mobile' field was removed because there is no column (emergency_contact holds name, relationship and number as one string), 'Change password' modal is still a mock toast (no endpoint; deferred). MC/grading file uploads: only the file name is sent as documentRef/bookFile. MC from/to dates are used only to compute the days (not stored).
9. student.js: seedBookings, checkEnded, queueRating, lastEndedClass, simulateNext, gaDemo, every save(), seeded flag removed; 'Prototype: mark your next class' lines removed from student_portal/index.html; renderBook builds slots from GET /student/timetable; every student page loads GET /student/home first (stuReady/stuPage in student.js; page handlers are async). portal.js student bell: the grading line uses GRADE.close/date instead of hardcoded text.
10. Landing: public-data.js adds ASK.load.sessions, ASK.act.trial, ASK.act.register; trial.js caches /public/sessions per day, sends lessonId (or time for private), the server prices and checks; join.js shows fees from DB.policies (server values) and posts the form, the done screen shows memberNo or 'Awaiting activation'; receipt tab uses the application id as receipt number. class.js/public.js/about.js unchanged (reference data from boot). Overseas passes oday/oweek/omonth are stored as day/week/month.
11. Transition stubs still present for later FEATs: save() no-op in store.js (instructor.js, admin-*.js still call it), recordMyAttendance, SEED()/fallbackSeed. No browser storage is used by student/landing pages except the allowed ask-home-view/ask-sound/ask-rail prefs.

HARNESS: api-public.mjs, api-student.mjs, browser-student.mjs under .be-tmp/verify (each resets the db and spawns its own app; db.mjs must be running; verified runs left it stopped, .dbport removed). Screens in .be-tmp/screens: student-home/packages/grading/profile/book (1280), student-book-390, landing-trial-done, landing-join-done. Time-of-day note: api-student's <4 h fixtures skip themselves if the server clock is within 2 h of midnight (Asia/Singapore).
